# CFTC Tail Findings — Dated Episode Lists

**Generated:** 2026-08-07 | **Spec:** episode-collapsed (v2), Rohit Aug 2026

## 1. LIQUIDITY EXIT — FM>70 vs FM>75 discontinuity

Rohit flagged: FM>75 is strict subset of FM>70, yet 4w mean *jumps up* at FM>75.
Week-level grid (no collapse) shows same pattern — not an artifact of episode logic.

| RM < | FM > | n (wk) | 4w avg (old) | n_ep (v2) | 4w mean (v2) |
|------|------|--------|--------------|------------|--------------|
| 20 | 70 | 60 | 0.4161 | 36 | 0.3848 |
| 20 | 75 | 50 | 1.2903 | 30 | 1.0048 |
| 25 | 70 | 76 | 0.1489 | 45 | 0.1838 |
| 25 | 75 | 65 | 0.9015 | 39 | 0.6839 |
| 30 | 70 | 89 | 0.44 | 51 | 0.4739 |
| 30 | 75 | 76 | 1.0864 | 45 | 0.946 |

### Mechanism: episodes dropped in 70–75 band are uniformly weak

FM>75 keeps only weeks where FM rolling pctile >75. Episodes that *start* in the 70–75 band
(FM not yet extreme enough) are excluded from FM>75 but included in FM>70. Those dropped
episodes have much lower 4w returns, dragging FM>70 mean down.
